sourceSentences: Periodically, Zyra spawns one or two Seeds nearby that last for 30 seconds, granting sight over the surrounding area for 1 second.
After 1 second, enemy champions can destroy Seeds by moving on top of them.

Zyra does not plant any Seeds if she is concealed within a brush (unless there is an enemy ward in it, in which case it takes her a little longer to plant the Seed) or when there is no room for additional ones.
Zyra sprouts thorny spines at the target location that appear after a 0.625-seconds delay, dealing magic damage to enemies hit.
If Deadly Spine hits a Seed, it sprouts into a Thorn Spitter that lasts for 8 seconds.

Zyra plants a Seed at the target location that remains for 60 seconds and grants sight over the surrounding area, though decreasing in radius after 1 second. After 1.5 seconds, enemy champions can destroy the Seed by stepping on it, which reveals them for 2 seconds.
Zyra periodically stocks a Seed charge, up to a maximum of 2. Killing an enemy generates 35% charge toward a Seed, increased to 100% for large enemies and whenever scoring an enemy champion takedown.
Zyra shoots a surge of vines in the target direction that deals magic damage to enemies hit and roots them for a duration.
If Grasping Roots hits a Seed, it sprouts into a Vine Lasher that lasts for 8 seconds.
Zyra summons a monstrous thicket at the target location that deals magic damage to enemies hit as it expands.
After 2 seconds, the thicket snaps upward to knock up enemies within for 1 second.

Garden of Thorns hit by the thicket become enraged, restoring health, increasing their maximum health by 50%, gaining 25% increased size and refreshing their duration while the thicket expands. Additionally they attack in a flurry, launching two shots per attack
Garden of Thorns grown during the 2 seconds prior to the displacement will also be enraged.
casting Q on a seed spawns a Thorn Spitter that continues attacking the enemy for 8 seconds
place a W seed between yourself and the enemy, then cast Q on the seed to spawn a Thorn Spitter
punish with E through a seed to root them and spawn a Vine Lasher that slows their retreat
This W-E-Q double plant combo is Zyra's bread-and-butter engage in bot lane
placing seeds inside the ultimate zone before or during the cast so that Q and E create enraged plants
cast R on as many enemies as possible, immediately follow with E and Q through seeds inside the ultimate zone
use seed placement and plant spawns to check brush and control vision around objectives
Enemy champions can destroy seeds by stepping on them.
